# ADR-XXXX: Short decision title

## Context

Describe the situation, related task, evidence, and constraints requiring a durable decision. Distinguish established facts from hypotheses.

## Decision

Record the date and decision actually made, its rationale, and affected interfaces or workflow. Do not represent a prospective patch strategy as decided before research establishes feasibility.

## Consequences

Describe tradeoffs, compatibility/validation implications, follow-up tasks, and unresolved limits. Link evidence and related decisions. Supersede with a new linked ADR if the decision changes.
